This '''unidentified [[Scout trooper/Legends|Scout trooper]]''' served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he took part in the [[Battle of Restuss]] on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. There, he was given the task of sniping [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] antennas.
